upgrade_catalog.label: Timer Reserve
upgrade_catalog.summary: Extends each run so upgraded rigs can squeeze in one more haul before the horn sounds.

upgrade_catalog.label: Route Planner
upgrade_catalog.summary: Trims wasted travel and stretches the timer by making each route more efficient.

upgrade_catalog.label: Engine Tuning
upgrade_catalog.summary: Boosts rig acceleration so short runs still feel punchy instead of sluggish.

upgrade_catalog.label: Dirt Softener
upgrade_catalog.summary: Keeps deeper layers from stealing too much speed away from the drill rig.

upgrade_catalog.label: Drill Torque
upgrade_catalog.summary: Raises drilling throughput so each pass breaks more rock before the timer runs dry.

upgrade_catalog.label: Drill Plating
upgrade_catalog.summary: Adds integrity to the bit so risky dives can survive tougher veins.

upgrade_catalog.label: Cooling Loop
upgrade_catalog.summary: Shaves off drill wear so health stays right on the edge instead of collapsing instantly.

upgrade_catalog.label: Cargo Pods
upgrade_catalog.summary: Lets each trip carry a few more chunks before you have to dump at the surface.

upgrade_catalog.label: Ore Refinery
upgrade_catalog.summary: Improves payout conversion so every dumped load is worth a little more.

upgrade_catalog.label: Vacuum Scoop
upgrade_catalog.summary: Widens the collection field so more of each broken node actually makes it into cargo.

upgrade_catalog.label: XP Calibration
upgrade_catalog.summary: Keeps progression climbing fast enough that new depths keep unlocking through the full run.

upgrade_catalog.label: Depth Scanner
upgrade_catalog.summary: Unlocks harder strata a little earlier when your rig can actually survive them.

upgrade_catalog.label: Salvage Drone
upgrade_catalog.summary: Launches bots that fly out to loose ore chunks so the player can stay on drilling lines.

upgrade_catalog.label: Delivery Drone
upgrade_catalog.summary: Dispatches separate bots that ferry cargo back to the base ring while you keep drilling.
